phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

mindset.hed: Be the Problem on the Floor
mindset.body: Wembanyama didn't wait for the game to come to him: 50 and 19. Stirling waited all of Round 2 and then ended it. Both own the moment because they did the work before it. Sunday is your setup day: lock the week, ship one real piece of 7EightMade, and walk into Monday already ahead. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Sunday, the Sun's day: run this right after Morning Charge. It's rainy and about 54 out, so keep the RipStick finisher in the garage or swap in 60 seconds of fast feet. Smooth, controlled reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

techDemo.title: Tech Demo
techDemo.kicker: Fast learn - from your X bookmarks
techDemo.pick: @hypertune_ showed how to check if your RAM runs at the speed you paid for: Task Manager, Performance, Memory, then compare "Speed" to the rated speed. If it is lower, the fix is usually turning on XMP/EXPO in BIOS.
techDemo.author: @hypertune_
techDemo.note: No new bookmarks since Nov 17, so this rotates an older real one (posted Oct 26). Lesson stays general; the post has the full steps.

lesson.oneLiner: Rated RAM speed is not automatic.
beats: Compare it to the speed on the RAM box or listing.
Lower? Enable XMP (Intel) or EXPO (AMD) in BIOS.
lesson.takeaway: A 2-minute check can unlock performance you already paid for.
